name: Cotton processing and circulating spindles
player_goal: DESIGN_HYPOTHESIS: plan a textile production batch while understanding stock committed to intermediate products.
player_actions: Process raw cotton with a cotton gin.
Spin cotton into cotton thread using a spindle and a spinning station.
Weave three cotton threads into cotton cloth.
preconditions: PROJECT_FACT: the selected recipes require a cotton gin, a spinning wheel or anchored tailoring bench, and a loom or floor loom.
MODEL ASSUMPTION: all stations are already accessible; 18 raw cotton, no initial intermediate products; no external supply.
rules: PROJECT_FACT: Process Cotton declares one raw cotton consumed and one cotton produced; the selected callback adds one cotton seed.
PROJECT_FACT: Make Cotton Thread declares three cotton and one spindle consumed for one cotton thread; the station is kept.
PROJECT_FACT: Make Cotton Cloth declares three cotton threads consumed for one cotton cloth; its selected callback adds three spindles and the loom is kept.
state_transitions: Raw cotton stock decreases; processed cotton and seed stock increase.
Three cotton and one available spindle become one cotton thread.
Three cotton threads become one cotton cloth and three available spindles.
feedback: UNVERIFIED: actual recipe UI, callback output visibility and inventory feedback have not been observed in this pilot.
failure_conditions: MODEL_RESULT (bounded abstraction): with fewer than three starting spindles and no initial thread or external supply, the selected chain cannot complete its first cloth.
success_conditions: MODEL_RESULT (bounded abstraction): with three starting spindles and all stations present, 18 raw cotton can complete two cloth in the bounded model.
expected_experiences: DESIGN_HYPOTHESIS: production planning feels understandable when the player can see stock temporarily committed to intermediate products.
design_risks: Inspecting only declarative recipe outputs misses callback byproducts and spindle returns.
A consumed spindle may be mistaken for a lost tool before the cloth step returns it.
A model without acquisition, runtime callbacks and station access cannot establish in-game reachability or balance.
validation_plan: Reproduce the pinned static-source facts using hashes and line locators.
Compare starting spindle stock 0, 1, 2 and 3 under identical scheduling assumptions.
Verify stock accounting across every simulated state.
In a separate game test profile, inspect inventories and callback errors after each recipe; no such runtime test is claimed here.
With consenting players, test whether they can predict the stock needed for a first cloth; record actual choices and subjective feedback separately.

consequences: Commit cotton and spindles to intermediate thread toward the cloth target.
Retain available spindle/cotton stock until the player has planned a complete batch; the modeled chain produces no cloth during deferral.

intentional_tradeoffs: The upstream project explicitly aims to complement vanilla Build 42 systems. This pilot does not prescribe additional economy, progression or crafting systems.
The original spindle circulation may be intentional. A bootstrap constraint is not automatically a defect.
